_meta.title: Working analysis: B2B dev-tool LP at 4.2% baseline (demo request)
_meta.why_strong_example: B2B SaaS analysis showing how 4.2% can be EXCELLENT for the niche; identifies that customer logo wall (in-ICP) and product screenshot are doing the heavy lift; warns against logo wall removal (a common 'modernization' move).

trust_anatomy.element: Customer logo wall (Vercel, Ramp, Coinbase, etc.)
trust_anatomy.why_working: ICP-recognized peer companies = social-proof shortcut. Visitor sees own peer-tier and assumes safe choice.
B2B SaaS conversion driver — show the product, not abstract benefit copy. Animation > static.

trust_anatomy.element: Specific case-study quote with first name + role + metric
trust_anatomy.why_working: 'Chintan, Head of Eng at Coinbase: shipped 2x faster' beats 'companies report higher productivity'

trust_anatomy.element: SOC 2 Type II badge in footer + Trust Center link
trust_anatomy.why_working: Procurement/IT gate; visible compliance reduces the deal-killer at $25K+ ACV
Third-party authority; specifically the 'Leader' quadrant matters

preservation_zones.reason: 22% load. Removing for 'cleaner minimal' has destroyed B2B LPs in published case studies.
20% load. The product IS the conversion driver in B2B SaaS.
12% load. Specific name + role + metric > generic testimonial.
8% load. Procurement/IT gate; visible compliance is a deal floor.
Sales-led B2B; 4 fields qualify the lead. Reducing to 2 fields would flood sales with low-quality leads.

change_safe_zones.reason: Tertiary content; copy variants safe to test
'Watch demo video' / 'Read docs' microcopy variants are low-risk
Re-ordering logos to highlight visitor-segment-relevant brands is a clean test (A/B by company size or industry)
Different feature highlighted in screenshot — test which feature drives best demo CVR

warnings_for_downstream: DO NOT propose customer logo wall removal. 22% load. This is the classic 'modernize' destruction pattern.
DO NOT propose replacing product screenshot with abstract illustration. 20% load.
DO NOT propose reducing demo-form below 4 fields without lead-quality evidence. Sales team will revolt + LP becomes a low-intent lead pump.
DO NOT propose adding urgency mechanisms ('limited demo slots'). Falsely manufactured urgency erodes B2B trust catastrophically.
Tests on the BELOW-FOLD copy and on SCREENSHOT VARIANTS are the highest-leverage low-risk test surface here.
